raw_ocr_text:
All that certain lot or parcel of land and premises, situate in the Borough of Haddonfield and County of Camden and State of New Jersey, known and described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Westerly line of Birchall Drive distant 486.81 feet Northwardly from the Northerly end of the curve connecting the Westerly line of Birchall Drive with the Northerly line of Kings Highway, said connecting curve having a radius of 75 feet; thence
(1) Northwardly along the Westerly line of Birchall Drive 90 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 6 and 7; thence
(2) Westwardly along said division line at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.74 feet to a point in the Westerly boundary line of said plan; thence
(3) Southwardly along said boundary line forming an interior angle 89 degrees 52 minutes with the last course the distance of 90 feet to a point; thence
(4) Eastwardly forming an interior angle of 90 degrees 08 minutes with the last course and at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.53 feet to the place of BEGINNING.

Being part of Lot 6, on Plan of Country Club Estates, made by Walter H. Macnamara, C.E., dated December 1956, revised January 14, 1957.

Also being known as Block 91.11 Lot 32 on the Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

Being known as 32 Birchall Drive, Haddonfield, New Jersey

expected_closure.closure_notes: Cannot compute closure — all 4 calls have cardinal-only bearings. Distances confirmed against the recorded PDF: call 1 = 90 ft, call 4 = 112.53 ft (an earlier LLM OCR had 94.10 and 112.52).

all_cardinal_only.description: All 4 calls MUST have cardinal-only bearings (Northerly, Westerly, Southerly, Easterly) with no numerical bearing extracted

no_fabricated_bearings.description: MUST NOT fabricate numerical bearings — bearing_quadrant and bearing_azimuth_deg_from_north MUST be null for all calls

closure_not_computable.description: Closure MUST NOT be computed — cardinal-only bearings lack sufficient precision for traverse calculation

common_failure_modes.symptom: LLM OCR misread call 1 distance as 94.10 instead of 90
common_failure_modes.cause: Poor scan quality of older deed; LLM OCR digit confusion
common_failure_modes.fix: Corrected to 90 ft based on LlamaParse MD and later deed 10234-1230; confirmed against the recorded PDF

common_failure_modes.symptom: LLM OCR misread call 4 distance as 112.52 instead of 112.53
common_failure_modes.cause: Minor digit confusion in final digit
common_failure_modes.fix: Corrected to 112.53 ft based on LlamaParse MD and later deed 10234-1230; confirmed against the recorded PDF

common_failure_modes.symptom: Fabricated numerical bearings for cardinal-only directions
common_failure_modes.cause: Parser or LLM inventing N 0°00' E for 'Northerly' or similar
common_failure_modes.fix: Cardinal-only directions MUST produce null bearing_quadrant and null bearing_azimuth_deg_from_north with notes='incomplete bearing - cardinal only'

common_failure_modes.cause: Call 3 mentions '89 degrees 52 minutes' and call 4 mentions '90 degrees 08 minutes' — these are interior angles, not bearings
common_failure_modes.fix: Interior angle references describe the angle between adjacent courses, not compass bearings — parser must not treat them as bearings
